program_name: Online Master of Science in Regulatory Science – Food Safety

programme_facts.value: Upon graduating, you’ll be prepared for careers in regulatory science and food safety across local, state and federal agencies, as well as the food industry. This program supports roles in organizations such as the FDA, U.S. Department of Agriculture, state health departments and food manufacturers.
